# `/review-pr`

> Fetch PR review comments, fix issues, reply to each comment

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-command-docs.py from commands/review-pr.md — do not edit -->

Fetches PR review comments, fixes the issues and replies to each comment.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Usage** | `/review-pr <pr-number>` |
| **Reads** | PR comments (via `gh`) |
| **Writes** | fixes, commits, replies |
| **Gates** | You confirm before fixes are applied. |
| **Next** | `/merge` |
| **Tools** | `Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob` |
